system.description: You can make Grab or Grapple attempts against any enemy within the reach of a Chain Sickle that you are wielding. These attempts use your weapon's attack bonus with in place of your Grapple modifier. When you would deal damage as part of a Grapple (such as through the Throw or Crush feats), you deal additional damage equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum +1).
